resolvedFindings.problem: Qualified profile matching silently skips a record missing a required subject field instead of retaining unresolved membership. Exclusion filters that record away, then can assert bounded absence despite the unresolved relevant observation. Base matching already treats missing fields conservatively.
resolvedFindings.proposedRepair: Use three-valued full subject membership for qualified matching: explicit different identities may be excluded, but missing/invalid fields and unresolved time/profile context remain unknown. Exclusion must retain any such unresolved relevant records and cannot turn them into an empty searched set. Add independent missing applicationId/agentId/actionId/stateKey/sessionId exclusion cases.
resolvedFindings.scenario: APP-R19 record with correct applicationId/agentId but missing actionId returns Q6=no; with explicit all-true coverage and both searches completed, APP-R20 returns Q594=yes rather than unknown.

resolvedFindings.problem: Lead readiness checks source nodeId/domain/profile subjects but ignores source questionId and whether the selected source profile actually defines that node. An invented qualified source or wrong qualified identity can open a nominally ready edge. Target qualification checks are substantially improved and pass independent host-state tests.
resolvedFindings.proposedRepair: Validate the source question identity against its exact node/profile/version. For restored nonterminal nodes, require sourceFacet applicability in the selected source profile or the actual qualified definition catalog. Unsupported source definitions remain unsupported/unknown and cannot be supplied as yes/no assessments. Preserve original source context and independently assessed target discovery.
resolvedFindings.scenario: APP-R21 accepts application-agent-action Q317 collaboration-artifacts as an affirmative source although this profile excludes Q317. APP-R22 accepts an arbitrary mismatched source questionId at supported Q310.

resolvedFindings.problem: The profile catalog evidenceRequirements line still presents a separately bound falsifiable hypothesis and answer as an unconditional requirement, while repaired definitions/runtime explicitly permit fact-led assessments without a hypothesis.
resolvedFindings.proposedRepair: Make the requirement conditional: when a hypothesis is supplied, retain its exact bound statement, criterion, alternatives and actual answer; otherwise factual questions retain their own observation/context/evidence.
resolvedFindings.scenario: APP-R07/R14 accept complete factual scope/effect evidence without a hypothesis, but an implementer reading the unconditional catalog requirement could reject that same permitted case.
independentChecks: Catalog evidenceRequirements inspected: classification requires a hypothesis; independent fact assessments may omit one.
